title: ticket template: intake (tracker read, template_version 1)
description: Read EXISTING tickets from the tracker -- manually created ones included -- so findings and dashboards show their ticket numbers and status. Sent as tickets.search params.tracker_query, paged with the tracker's own cursor (page_token). Projects are limited to those this repository's routing and ledger name; the JQL is wrapped as project in (...) AND (<jql>) and may not carry ORDER BY. Jira is built; FreshService is the adapter seam (TRACKER_INTAKE_NOT_CONFIGURED until built).
